{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# First, ensure sample_seq is int (it is)
df = df.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])
# Keep only the first (highest sample_seq) row per patient
df_dedup = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Now filter to treatment arm only
treatment_df = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute the fraction of patients who responded
n_total = len(treatment_df)
n_responded = treatment_df['responded'].sum()
fraction_responded = n_responded / n_total

print(f'Number of unique patients in treatment arm: {n_total}')
print(f'Number of responders in treatment arm: {n_responded}')
print(f'Fraction responded: {fraction_responded:.4f}')

# Output the result
treatment_df.head()"}
